## Name & positioning

## FAQ
Q1. What is ReviewMiner?
A1. ReviewMiner mines customer reviews for sentiment splits and recurring themes.
Q2. What do I paste in?
A2. A set of reviews or a CSV-like snippet with enough volume to analyze.
Q3. Who should use it?
A3. Product and CX teams scanning qualitative feedback.
Q4. Does it invent quotes?
A4. No. Treat outputs as analysis; keep original reviews as source of truth.
Q5. How many reviews do I need?
A5. More is better; very small samples get honesty warnings.
Q6. Does it guarantee accuracy?
A6. No. It is decision-support summarization, not a certified research study.
